title: Design: A long payer name on the phone customer page keeps Change visible
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, a payer, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have two new customers for this test, customer D and customer E, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer A and customer B in turn.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-26-after-phone.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer D's page.
  2. Open customer E's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer A's name and "Change".
  • Customer A's name stays inside the card: no part of it runs past the right edge of the screen or covers "Change".
  • "Change" is fully visible without scrolling the page sideways.

Step 2:

  • The card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name and "Change".
  • Customer B's name stays inside the card: no part of it runs past the right edge of the screen or covers "Change".
  • "Change" is fully visible without scrolling the page sideways.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R2: “Users who may set the default see "Change" beside the name; it opens the "Bill Invoices To" window.”
  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Phone" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-26-after-phone.png

The design's own words:

  • “The same "Bill Invoices To" line with "Change", under IBS. Nothing phone-only.”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
